nar.io is a Nix binary cache backed by content-addressed storage (CAS). Unlike traditional Nix caches that store each NAR file separately, nar.io deduplicates at the chunk level - meaning you only pay for unique bytes.
, an MIT-licensed Nix binary cache implementation. You can self-host it, or use our managed service.
